items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: We played there with Louis and Paul Dominguez and them.

ctx.x: She had to remember her. She had to remember her. We played there with Louis and Paul Dominguez and them. She was the one playing the piano with them. Well anyhow that was the band we played then. We advertised and then George Lewis was the town that played. Later on of course we were going to get some other jobs, some other places. But that's where I was studying.
